info.title: PANTAU API
info.description: Tenant API for devices, cameras, sites, grants, agents and the audit log. Authentication, two-factor and organizations (tenants) are provided by Better Auth under `/api/auth/*`; a session cookie is required on every `/v1` endpoint except `POST /v1/agent/enroll`, whose single-use enrollment token is the credential. The on-site agent connects to the WebSocket `/agent` (not described here; see packages/contracts/src/agent.ts and docs/DECISIONS.md D25). Errors use `application/problem+json`.

get.summary: Readiness: every registered check (PostgreSQL, later pg-boss) must pass within the deadline

patch.summary: Edit a site (name, address, time zone)

delete.summary: Delete a site with its devices, cameras and grants (owner or noc)

post.summary: Add a device manually, probe it (ONVIF, read-only) and create its cameras
post.description: Credentials are used to probe and are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); they are never returned, logged or audited.

get.summary: List devices of the current tenant
Get a device with its capabilities and cameras
List cameras of the current tenant

patch.summary: Rename or reorder a camera (capabilities come from probing and cannot be edited)

post.summary: Take a JPEG snapshot from a camera
post.description: Responds with `image/jpeg` bytes. Every attempt is written to the audit log.

get.summary: List grants. Owner and noc see the tenant; everyone else sees only their own.

post.summary: Grant a member view or operate access to a site or one camera (owner or noc)
Mint a single-use agent enrollment token for a site (owner or noc)
post.description: The token is valid 24 hours, is returned once and only its SHA-256 is stored.

post.summary: Register an agent with an enrollment token (header `Authorization: Enroll <token>`)
post.description: Public endpoint: the single-use token is the credential. Returns the long-lived agent token once.

post.summary: Revoke an agent's token and close its connection (owner or noc). Idempotent.

get.summary: Audit log of the current tenant (owner or noc), filterable by action and time
